Resolves #21062

A `Neo.menu.List` cascade driven by a `Neo.data.TreeStore` now lists only the records the store's filters keep, at every level. This holds whether the filter was set before the menu existed or changes while the menu is open. `TreeStore#isKept()` makes the store's ancestor-aware mask public. Each level applies it when deriving its records from `getChildren()`, which stays filter-independent. A level also re-derives on the store's `filter` event, skips additions the filters hide, and hides a submenu once its item leaves the level.

Evidence: L2 (unit contract tests over a real TreeStore and real menu levels; red on `dev` @ fbb9c4da19 in a base worktree, green on head) → L2 required (every #21062 AC is a data and menu-state contract). No residuals.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 a filter set first reaches every level | CI: `test/playwright/unit/menu/ListTreeStore.spec.mjs` "a filter set before the menu exists reaches every level, a kept ancestor included" |
| AC-2 changing or clearing re-derives live levels | CI: same spec, "changing or clearing the filters re-derives every live level" |
| AC-3 an addition under a filter | CI: same spec, "a record added under an active filter joins its level only when the filter keeps it" (also asserts the level holds the source's instance once) |
| AC-4 the open submenu of a dropped item hides | CI: same spec, "a filter that drops the item of the open submenu hides that submenu" |
| AC-5 no `filter` listener left behind | CI: same spec, "a destroyed level leaves no listener behind on the still-live source", extended to `filter` |
| AC-6 `getChildren()` stays filter-independent | CI: AC-1's test asserts `getChildren('root')` still returns all three roots under the filter; the existing child-level tests stay green |
| AC-7 classic menus unchanged | CI: same spec, "the classic nested-items API is untouched" |
| AC-8 menu and data unit dirs green | CI: unit job (full local run: 7417 passed, 2 skipped) |

## Deltas from ticket

- The orphaned-submenu hide also runs when a source removal takes the item away, not only a filter. Same defect class, same helper.
- `collectVisibleDescendants()` and `updateSiblingStats()` keep reading the mask directly: they are hot loops that already hold canonical keys. The ticket's Fix now says so.
- The ticket's first reproducer cited a descendant-preservation case (a parent that matches a filter keeps its subtree, by design). It is corrected in the ticket body.

## Test Evidence

Red-on-base: the five new or extended tests fail on `dev` @ fbb9c4da19, run in a detached base worktree with only this spec copied in (15 passed, 5 failed). All 20 pass on head. Everything else runs in CI.
